text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Gold City!!
You were so cool~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That was incredible——!!
What an amazing Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Did you hear the cheers?
They said... I was 'strong'...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Does this mean... you only looked at my running... Right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pfft. What's with that energy?
My hype just completely died down, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I've finally made it to the starting line
as 'Gold City'...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's kind of weird—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City murmured as if savoring those words.
Starting tomorrow, her brand-new day would begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, City is going crazy viral.
Umatter and Umastagram are nothing but City right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"People are calling you 'fast' more than 'pretty.'
...Good for you, City."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is this Umart link
gonna take me to some other website...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...W-What is this!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you startled me.
What are you shouting for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I thought I just saw
"Gold City" written somewhere, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...!!
N-No, don't look, pervert!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Well now I'm curious.
Lemme see.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: N-NO WAY!! No can do~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...! Don't run away!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, stop chasing me!!
As if I could ever outrun City!?
Give me a break~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then just quietly hand over
what you were looking at before...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I told you, anything but that!!
Even if you beat me to a pulp, no way—eep?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pop!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh, my phone!
I'm gonna crack the screen again!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, barely made it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Lady Cityyy!! Thank youuu!!
I really thought it was all over for me this timeee!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And the passcode is... this one, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gah!? W-Wait—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm? What, were you browsing an anonymous message board?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's... this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""【Races】 Gold City is way too gorgeous"
"Anyone got a compilation of Gold City pics?"
"Gold City's racing outfit is just...""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
">>2 Who is this Umamusume? Totally my type."
">>3 That's Gold City. She ran in the Kikuka Sho, so expect to see her a lot more in the media."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
">>3 She works as a model, so just look her up and you'll find tons of pics."
">>5 Looked her up, wait, was she really a child actress too?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
">>6 She's been an angel since she was a kid."
"People only just realizing Gold City is gorgeous? Are you all race casuals or what?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "The more races she enters, the more exposure she gets, so I hope she keeps it up. She's so beautiful and strong, she's gonna become a legend. Can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat the crap outta every last one of 'em!
And if that doesn't work, I'll drag out the website admins—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Chill out. They're not dissing you or anything.
They're just talking about me like normal."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Still! You worked this hard precisely because
you didn't want things to end up like this, didn't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And yet...! These guys don't care
about how you feel at all...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's just so frustrating...!
It's so daaaaaaamn annoying...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Idiot, why are you the one crying?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I told you I'm fine.
Because now... I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It means that running... doesn't mean a damn thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—When Tosen Jordan came barging into the
Trainer's office in tears, not even two full days
had passed since the race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I heard it from Jordan.
So you get it now too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong I become,
it seems I'm destined to remain just a pretty doll.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Can you say that for sure?
In the end, people will always judge by looks...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Far from it—the more I run,
the more people show up who only care about looks.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What now?
It's over, you know. The Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is there really any better stage
to show off our running?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And yet... what did I do wrong?
I gave it everything I had...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why won't anyone just look at me? At nothing but my own ability...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The competitive fire that had always driven her was nowhere to be seen—
she merely seemed tormented by a hollow sense of emptiness.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you the one apologizing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beauty leaves a powerful impression on people's hearts.
The recognition she truly desires will take time to rebuild.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then all we can do right now—
is not give up, and keep on running."
choice_data_list: Why don't we enter the "Arima Kinen"?
Do you want to run in the "Arima Kinen"?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did you even hear me?
I told you, there's no point in running.
choice_data_list: The year-end Grand Prix is just as exciting.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Are you trying to say there's still a chance?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Do you still think
I can show who I truly am through running?
choice_data_list: The path you chose isn't over yet.
The path you chose isn't over yet

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Alright.
I'll run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Because I... want to believe
that it's not over yet, too."
